data.title: Building enquiry for garden house rejected
data.summary: The Building Authority (Baurechtsamt) of the City of Beispielheim rejected your preliminary building enquiry of 12 January 2026 for a garden house. The letter is dated 2 March 2026 and you may file an objection (Widerspruch) within one month of notification.
data.explanation: The city rejected your enquiry (Bauvoranfrage) for a 42 m³ garden house in the outside area (Außenbereich), because it harms public interests under § 35 para. 2 BauGB. You may decide whether to file an objection (Widerspruch). It must be in writing or recorded at the city office, and the app shows the deadline. It can also reach the competent objection authority in time. If you do nothing, the rejection becomes final. A separate fee notice (Gebührenbescheid) will follow. A specialist in building law can advise if you are unsure.

items.title: File objection against rejection
items.action: If you disagree, file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the City of Beispielheim or have it recorded there.
items.consequence: Without an objection in time, the rejection becomes final.
items.quote: Rechtsbehelf: Widerspruch. Frist: ein Monat ab Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids.
